newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Commerical Bank sells share in Attica Bank.
newsitem.headline: Greek Commerical Bank sells share in Attica Bank.

text.p: The state Commercial Bank of Greece sold a 39.5 percent stake in the state Bank of Attica to two funds for a total of 9.41 billion drachmas, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou said in a statement.
"It was completed successfully the first de-nationalisation of a bank of the greater public sector," Papandoniou said.

Commercial Bank will sell its 24 percent in the Bank of Attica to the engineers' pension fund (TSMEDE) for 6.46 billion drachmas and an additional 15.5 percent stake to the state-run deposit and loans fund (TPD) for 2.945 billion drachmas, the statement said.
Commercial Bank will retain a stake of about 20 percent at the Bank of Attica and will appoint its management for five years.

The agreement caps a long saga that lasted for almost two years. The formal approval of the deal by the board of directors of the Commercial Bank is pending although it is consider a formality. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
